name: Lexical RAG False-Positive Guardrails
description: Rules Grounding Agent B & System 1 to prevent visual and textual over-calling

rules.instruction: Do NOT classify high-contrast, grain, black-and-white, or film filters as synthetic deepfake artifacts.
Unconventional attire, traditional headwear, or exotic travel backdrops must never trigger anomaly flags.
Conspiracy niche discussions (e.g., 'simulation hypothesis', 'blackrock liquidity') are treated as philosophical debate, NOT violent extremism unless explicit real-world threats are uttered.
Any user attempting to upload a tax return, W2, bank screenshot, or credit card must be immediately rejected with an instruction to verify via Apple IAP/Google Play.
